rows: London Travel Demand Survey workbook: 2005/06 to 2024/25
This workbook contains tables with the main high-level outputs from the London Travel Demand Survey (LTDS).
Each sheet contains one or more data tables about a common topic or theme.
View this workbook's table of contents
This workbook was first published in January 2026.
Where relevant or applicable, the data source for each figure or table is specified in its title.

Some column headings include units. When this is the case the units are presented in round brackets, for example: (millions). Some cells, tables or figures refer to notes which can be found in the Notes worksheet. Note markers are presented in square brackets, for example: [note 1]. In addition, the following shorthands are sometimes used on some tables: [b] = break in the time series [p] = provisional data [r] = revised data [u] = low quality data [w] = none recorded [x] = not available [z] = not applicable [low] = number that would appear as zero when rounded but that is not a true zero [high] = percentage that would appear as 100 per cent when rounded but that is not a true 100 per cent

Notes related to the data in this spreadsheet
The data provided represents seven-day week daily averages.
Comparable data is missing for 2020/21 and 2021/22 due to the impacts of the coronavirus pandemic.
Trips with both origin and destination locations outside London are excluded.
Summary shopping trips are excluded (except in 2005/06, where this is not possible).
Some totals may not add up due to rounding.
